content.text: The cause is in `_expired`: it uses `>`, so an entry whose age equals the TTL still counts as live. The test expects an entry to expire at exactly `ttl` seconds, so the comparison should be `>=`. I'll make that one-character change.

content.text: The visible suite now passes (`1 passed`). I changed one file, `solution/core.py`. The cause was in `TTLCache._expired`, which used `self.clock() - ts > self.ttl`. That treated an entry as live at exactly `ttl` seconds of age, so `get` returned the value at t=10.0 when the TTL was 10.0. I changed the comparison to `>=` so an entry expires once its age reaches the TTL. `put` and `get` both go through `_expired`, so the capacity check and the lookup now agree. I did not touch anything under `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `TTLCache` public API.
